options.title: Stanley Sold {fact1} a Year. Then One Cup Went Viral
options.first_line: In 2019, Stanley sold {fact1} a year. Then one cup went viral.
options.first_frame: A Stanley Quencher on a shop shelf, the camera pushing in, its name label wiping in as the 2019 sales figure counts up over it.

options.title: The Stanley Cup Nobody Wanted Became a Craze
options.first_line: Stanley's big cup barely sold. Then it became the cup everyone had to have.
options.first_frame: A Stanley Quencher held up in a shop, a red 'barely sold' tag slamming on it.

options.title: Stanley Made Flasks for Builders. Then One Cup Took Over
options.first_line: For generations, Stanley made green flasks for builders and campers. Then one cup took over.
options.first_frame: An old green Stanley vacuum bottle on a museum shelf, the camera pushing in, then a hard cut to a pastel Quencher.

why: It names a cup viewers own and gives only the before figure, so the after figure is a question you must stay for, while B and C already say it became a craze or took over.
